mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases when both series rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (unemployment rate below 4.0%), strong job growth supports consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 100.0 indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and economic activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises above 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts and GDP growth signals strong aggregate demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases when both series rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
